description: Rejects hallucinatory claims of computing an unconstrained 50-variable global Groebner basis for ideal I_55 in a single step without cylindrical coordinate slice restriction.
negative_fixture: The global 50-variable Groebner basis computed for I_55 proves that the complete variety of 6x6 complex Hadamard matrices is 4-dimensional.
